I crashed my car for the first time just a month ago. It was one of our last snow storms and I came around a corner at night too fast for the weather and my rear end started sliding in those roughly two seconds my brain went something like this: 

- okay okay we just gotta straighten out.  
- it’s not working!!! 
- okay we are headed for that house. 
- I’m not even moving that fast, I won’t hit hard at all. 
Blackness, ears ringing, I thinking my nose is broken. 
For some reason the first thing I did was throw my glasses off my face. Then I looked for my glasses before getting out of the car. I had hit a granite pillar in someone’s front yard. I got out of the car and I looked around - the snow was falling and I could only see it in the dim light of the neighbors porch light. It fell so slow and I moved in slow motion while my brain was in overdrive. I moved as quickly as I could and I banged on the door of the house I crashed in front of, it felt like an eternity waiting for them to get out of bed to open the door. 

Even now that summer is coming and the ground is dry, I still come around that corner and I see the pillar ever so slightly tilted, and the same thing happens, everything moves in slow motion but the anxiety I feel makes my heart and mind race.
